label: Remotion picture adapter
summary: Use the project Remotion renderer for promptable, audio-reactive films, then cross the renderer-neutral picture review boundary before YouTube assembly.

handoffs.label: Render a promptable film and capture it for review
handoffs.intent: Develop an editable visual score against an approved master while keeping the rendered film portable beyond Remotion.
inputs: An approved lossless master and a versioned visual score or preset
Declared visual intent, source rights, tool/version, operator, render settings, and unknowns
outputs: An H.264 yuv420p progressive BT.709 render with even dimensions beginning at master time zero
An eprs.picture-candidate/v1 copy plus editable score evidence and a separate complete-picture review
steps: Preview the visual score locally and refine only against the stated musical relationship.
Render a film matching the approved master duration; embedded audio is guide-only.
Capture the film with eprs picture add, declare changes and unknowns, then watch every frame before recording keep, change, or stop.
verification: Confirm duration within frame tolerance, H.264/yuv420p/progressive BT.709 properties, even dimensions, and preserved source checksum.
Confirm the editable visual score is frozen as evidence and no capture, render, or technical check implies creative or publication approval.

preserve: The approved lossless master, editable visual score, prompt/seed/settings evidence, original render, and renderer-neutral captured copy
Musical space for faces, breath, silence, dynamics, and ambiguity rather than automatically illustrating every event
avoid: Unlicensed footage, silent insertion of faces or model output, opaque renderer defaults presented as known state, or trusting embedded guide audio
Overwriting prior renders, using FINAL as scratch space, or treating technical success as picture, sync, upload, or publication approval
